name: stand
title: Motor stand
description: A plate and a foot: clamp the foot to a table edge and the motor bolts to the back of the plate, its shaft sticking out over the edge. The dial, the mesh rig and the shoulder bolt to the front, on the same four holes. Prints on its front face, as a plain rectangle.

width.rule: Round the NEMA 17's 42 mm, with a margin for its screws

plate.rule: Enough for M3 screws, 1.5 × their size

corner.rule: Corners rounded so they stay down

foot.rule: Reaches back under the motor's 40 mm body, for a G-clamp behind it

rib.rule: Gussets each side of the plate, at 45°, so they print

segments.rule: Facets on round holes and corners
